name: Split Curtain Scroll Reveal
description: Long-form editorial page with an animated intro, chapter text and pull quote, then a pinned section where a big split heading opens like a curtain to reveal scrolling text over parallax images.
contents: Intro with split headline lines, author, year, scroll cue and note
Leading chapter with sticky numeral, title, drop-cap paragraphs and pull quote
Pinned reveal stage with split heading, scrolling paragraphs and parallax images
Trailing chapter with two-column paragraphs and closing quote
behavior: Intro lines slide up on load and drift sideways while scrolling away
Stage pins while a clip-path curtain opens and the heading halves split apart
Reveal paragraphs scroll up through the stage while images move at their own speeds
Paragraphs and quotes lift into place as they enter the viewport
Reduced motion users get the final opened state without animation

props.name: introNote
props.default: In which a white rabbit leads Alice astray.

props.name: pullQuote
props.default: “And what is the use of a book,” thought Alice, “without pictures or conversations?”

editableByProps: All text, chapters, paragraphs, quotes and the split heading
Parallax images with position, size, blur, depth and speed
Colors for page, stage, curtain and text
Fonts, type sizes, easing, split distance and pin length

needsCodeEdit.change: Remove the drop cap on first paragraphs
Change the lift-in distance of paragraphs

fixed: Loads the EB Garamond and Open Sans fonts from Google Fonts at runtime
Pins the reveal stage and adds scroll length for the pin; pinExtraScroll controls the extra distance
Intro section fills at least the viewport height
Needs at least two split heading halves in the markup for the curtain split effect
